profile.availability: I'm currently open to new opportunities. Whether you have a project in mind or just want to connect — my inbox is always open.

profile.motto: Building beyond the interface — from intuitive experiences to powerful backend systems.

paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with around three years of experience in web development, passionate about creating modern, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions.

I specialize in building responsive and interactive web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, while developing backend solutions with NestJS, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and GraphQL. I also enjoy working with headless CMS architectures to create flexible and maintainable applications.

My approach to development focuses on clean architecture, performance, accessibility, and maintainable code. I enjoy solving complex problems, exploring emerging technologies, and transforming ideas into meaningful digital experiences.
Driven by curiosity and continuous learning, I'm always looking for opportunities to grow, collaborate, and build impactful software that delivers real value.

details: Studied software engineering with a focus on software development, programming, problem-solving, and practical technology projects, building a strong foundation in modern software engineering.
Pursued specialized training in full-stack development, focusing on frontend and backend technologies, web application development, and practical software development skills.
Completed secondary education, establishing an academic foundation for pursuing higher education in software engineering and technology.

backend.title: Backend & API Development

frontend.title: Frontend Engineering
frontend.description: Creating responsive, interactive, and maintainable user interfaces for complex business applications and digital platforms.

fintech.title: FinTech & Banking Solutions
fintech.description: Developing financial technology platforms and banking applications, including card request systems, digital wallets, investment platforms, and merchant service integrations.

enterprise.description: Building internal business applications, workforce management platforms, payroll systems, and operational dashboards that support organizational workflows.

security.title: Security & Access Control
security.description: Implementing protected application workflows, role-based interfaces, and encrypted API communication for business and financial platforms.

quality.title: Software Quality & Testing
quality.description: Improving software reliability and maintainability through automated testing, systematic debugging, code reviews, and technical documentation.

ibank-cambodia.title: Frontend Developer
ibank-cambodia.description: Developing internal business and staff management systems, supporting operational workflows and integrating external service portals into banking applications.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain internal applications supporting staff and business operations.
Build intuitive and maintainable interfaces for internal users.
Support the digitization of business workflows and operational processes.
Integrate external service portals, including Electricité du Cambodge (EDC), Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority (PPWSA), and other merchant services.
Focus on application reliability, usability, performance, and maintainability.
Support ongoing improvements to internal business applications and service integrations.

aibodia.title: Full-Stack Developer
aibodia.description: Developed end-to-end software solutions across financial technology, workforce management, real-time communication, investment, and e-commerce platforms, contributing to both frontend and backend development.

card-request.name: Card Request Platform
bullets: Led frontend development of a KYC-enabled platform supporting virtual and physical card requests, transfers, top-ups, withdrawals, and eSIM purchases.
Architected admin, agent, and client-facing dashboards for multiple user roles.
Implemented end-to-end encryption for API request and response data.
Maintained software quality through unit, end-to-end, and load testing.

hr-management.name: HR Management Platform
bullets: Developed an internal HR and payroll management system with dedicated employee and administrator modules.
Implemented GPS and device-based attendance tracking.
Supported real-time workforce monitoring and automated HR workflows.

chat-sdk.name: Chat SDK
bullets: Developed a real-time communication SDK supporting text, voice, and emoji messaging.
Supported progressive web applications and desktop application compatibility.

investment-ecommerce.name: Investment & E-commerce Platform
bullets: Developed a unified wallet-based platform supporting investment, online shopping, and referral rewards.

isb-vietnam.title: Full-Stack Developer
isb-vietnam.description: Collaborated with international engineering teams in Vietnam to develop and maintain software applications, improve system stability, and deliver reliable and maintainable software solutions.
responsibilities: Developed new features across multiple software projects.
Maintained and improved existing legacy codebases.
Identified and resolved software defects through systematic debugging.
Conducted code reviews to maintain engineering quality and best practices.
Prepared technical documentation, test case designs, and test evidence reports to support quality assurance processes.
Collaborated with international team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
